verses.en: And Jesus entered and passed through Jericho.
verses.pt: E Jesus entrou e foi passando por Jericó.
verses.en_web: He entered and was passing through Jericho.
verses.en_bbe: And he went into Jericho, and when he was going through it,

verses.en: And, behold, there was a man named Zacchaeus, which was the chief among the publicans, and he was rich.
verses.pt: E eis que havia ali um homem, chamado pelo nome de Zaqueu, e este era chefe dos publicanos, e era rico.
verses.en_web: There was a man named Zacchaeus. He was a chief tax collector, and he was rich.
verses.en_bbe: A man, named Zacchaeus, who was the chief tax-farmer, and a man of wealth,

verses.en: And he sought to see Jesus who he was; and could not for the press, because he was little of stature.
verses.pt: E procurava ver quem era Jesus, e não podia, por causa da multidão, pois era pequeno de altura.
verses.en_web: He was trying to see who Jesus was, and couldn’t because of the crowd, because he was short.
verses.en_bbe: Made an attempt to get a view of Jesus, and was not able to do so, because of the people, for he was a small man.

verses.en: And he ran before, and climbed up into a sycomore tree to see him: for he was to pass that way.
verses.pt: E correndo com antecedência, subiu em uma árvore de frutos que parecem figos, para o ver; porque ele passaria por ali.
verses.en_web: He ran on ahead, and climbed up into a sycamore tree to see him, for he was going to pass that way.
verses.en_bbe: And he went quickly in front of them and got up into a tree to see him, for he was going that way.

verses.en: And when Jesus came to the place, he looked up, and saw him, and said unto him, Zacchaeus, make haste, and come down; for to day I must abide at thy house.
verses.pt: E quando Jesus chegou a aquele lugar, olhando para cima, o viu, e disse-lhe: Zaqueu, apressa-te, e desce; porque hoje é necessário que eu fique em tua casa.
verses.en_web: When Jesus came to the place, he looked up and saw him, and said to him, “Zacchaeus, hurry and come down, for today I must stay at your house.”
verses.en_bbe: And when Jesus came to the place, looking up, he said to him, Zacchaeus, be quick and come down, for I am coming to your house today.

verses.en: And he made haste, and came down, and received him joyfully.
verses.pt: E apressando-se, desceu, e o recebeu com alegria.
verses.en_web: He hurried, came down, and received him joyfully.
verses.en_bbe: And he came down quickly, and took him into his house with joy.

verses.en: And when they saw it, they all murmured, saying, That he was gone to be guest with a man that is a sinner.
verses.pt: E todos, vendo isto, murmuravam, dizendo: Ele entrou para se hospedar com um homem pecador.
verses.en_web: When they saw it, they all murmured, saying, “He has gone in to lodge with a man who is a sinner.”
verses.en_bbe: And when they saw it, they were all angry, saying, He has gone into the house of a sinner.

verses.en: And Zacchaeus stood, and said unto the Lord; Behold, Lord, the half of my goods I give to the poor; and if I have taken any thing from any man by false accusation, I restore him fourfold.
verses.pt: E Zaqueu, levantando-se, disse ao Senhor: Senhor, eis que dou a metade de meus bens aos pobres; e se eu consegui algo enganando a alguém, eu o devolvo quatro vezes mais.
verses.en_web: Zacchaeus stood and said to the Lord, “Behold, Lord, half of my goods I give to the poor. If I have wrongfully exacted anything of anyone, I restore four times as much.”
verses.en_bbe: And Zacchaeus, waiting before him, said to the Lord, See, Lord, half of my goods I give to the poor, and if I have taken anything from anyone wrongly, I give him back four times as much.

verses.en: And Jesus said unto him, This day is salvation come to this house, forsomuch as he also is a son of Abraham.
verses.pt: E Jesus lhe disse: Hoje houve salvação nesta casa, porque ele também é filho de Abraão.
verses.en_web: Jesus said to him, “Today, salvation has come to this house, because he also is a son of Abraham.
verses.en_bbe: And Jesus said to him, Today salvation has come to this house, for even he is a son of Abraham.

verses.en: For the Son of man is come to seek and to save that which was lost.
verses.pt: Porque o Filho do homem veio para buscar, e para salvar o que tinha se perdido.
verses.en_web: For the Son of Man came to seek and to save that which was lost.”
verses.en_bbe: For the Son of man came to make search for those who are wandering from the way, and to be their Saviour.

verses.en: And as they heard these things, he added and spake a parable, because he was nigh to Jerusalem, and because they thought that the kingdom of God should immediately appear.
verses.pt: E ouvindo eles estas coisas, Jesus prosseguiu, e disse uma parábola, porque estava perto de Jerusalém, e pensavam que logo o Reino seria manifesto.
verses.en_web: As they heard these things, he went on and told a parable, because he was near Jerusalem, and they supposed that God’s Kingdom would be revealed immediately.
verses.en_bbe: And while they were giving ear to these words, he made another story for them, because he was near Jerusalem, and because they were of the opinion that the kingdom of God was coming straight away.

verses.en: He said therefore, A certain nobleman went into a far country to receive for himself a kingdom, and to return.
verses.pt: Disse, pois: Um certo homem nobre partiu para uma terra distante.
verses.en_web: He said therefore, “A certain nobleman went into a far country to receive for himself a kingdom, and to return.
verses.en_bbe: So he said, A certain man of high birth went into a far-away country to get a kingdom for himself, and to come back.

verses.en: And he called his ten servants, and delivered them ten pounds, and said unto them, Occupy till I come.
verses.pt: E chamando dez servos seus, deu-lhes dez minas, e disse-lhes: Investi até que eu venha;
verses.en_web: He called ten servants of his, and gave them ten mina coins, and told them, ‘Conduct business until I come.’
verses.en_bbe: And he sent for ten of his servants and gave them ten pounds and said to them, Do business with this till I come.

verses.en: But his citizens hated him, and sent a message after him, saying, We will not have this man to reign over us.
verses.pt: E seus cidadãos o odiavam; e mandaram representantes depois dele, dizendo: Não queremos que este reine sobre nós.
verses.en_web: But his citizens hated him, and sent an envoy after him, saying, ‘We don’t want this man to reign over us.’
verses.en_bbe: But his people had no love for him, and sent representatives after him, saying, We will not have this man for our ruler.

verses.en: And it came to pass, that when he was returned, having received the kingdom, then he commanded these servants to be called unto him, to whom he had given the money, that he might know how much every man had gained by trading.
verses.pt: E aconteceu que, quando ele voltou, tendo tomado o reino, disse que lhe chamassem a aqueles servos, a quem tinha dado o dinheiro, para saber o que cada um tinha ganho fazendo investimentos.
verses.en_web: “When he had come back again, having received the kingdom, he commanded these servants, to whom he had given the money, to be called to him, that he might know what they had gained by conducting business.
verses.en_bbe: And when he came back again, having got his kingdom, he gave orders for those servants to whom he had given the money to come to him, so that he might have an account of what business they had done.

verses.en: Then came the first, saying, Lord, thy pound hath gained ten pounds.
verses.pt: E veio o primeiro, dizendo: Senhor, tua mina rendeu outras dez minas.
verses.en_web: The first came before him, saying, ‘Lord, your mina has made ten more minas.’
verses.en_bbe: And the first came before him, saying, Lord, your pound has made ten pounds.

verses.en: And he said unto him, Well, thou good servant: because thou hast been faithful in a very little, have thou authority over ten cities.
verses.pt: E ele lhe disse: Ótimo, bom servo! Por teres sido fiel no pouco, terás autoridade sobre dez cidades.
verses.en_web: “He said to him, ‘Well done, you good servant! Because you were found faithful with very little, you shall have authority over ten cities.’
verses.en_bbe: And he said to him, You have done well, O good servant: because you have done well in a small thing you will have authority over ten towns.

verses.en: And the second came, saying, Lord, thy pound hath gained five pounds.
verses.pt: E veio o segundo, dizendo: Senhor, tua mina rendeu cinco minas.
verses.en_web: “The second came, saying, ‘Your mina, Lord, has made five minas.’
verses.en_bbe: And another came, saying, Your pound has made five pounds.

verses.en: And he said likewise to him, Be thou also over five cities.
verses.pt: E disse também a este: E tu governarás cinco cidades.
verses.en_web: “So he said to him, ‘And you are to be over five cities.’
verses.en_bbe: And he said, You will be ruler over five towns.

verses.en: And another came, saying, Lord, behold, here is thy pound, which I have kept laid up in a napkin:
verses.pt: E veio outro, dizendo: Eis aqui tua mina, que guardei em um lenço.
verses.en_web: Another came, saying, ‘Lord, behold, your mina, which I kept laid away in a handkerchief,
verses.en_bbe: And another came, saying, Lord, here is your pound, which I put away in a cloth;

verses.en: For I feared thee, because thou art an austere man: thou takest up that thou layedst not down, and reapest that thou didst not sow.
verses.pt: Porque tive medo de ti, que és um homem rigoroso, que tomas o que não puseste, e colhes o que não semeaste.
verses.en_web: for I feared you, because you are an exacting man. You take up that which you didn’t lay down, and reap that which you didn’t sow.’
verses.en_bbe: Because I was in fear of you, for you are a hard man: you take up what you have not put down, and get in grain where you have not put seed.

verses.en: And he saith unto him, Out of thine own mouth will I judge thee, thou wicked servant. Thou knewest that I was an austere man, taking up that I laid not down, and reaping that I did not sow:
verses.pt: Porém ele lhe disse: Servo mau, por tua boca eu te julgarei; tu sabias que eu era um homem rigoroso, que tomo o que não pus, e que colho o que não semeei;
verses.en_web: “He said to him, ‘Out of your own mouth will I judge you, you wicked servant! You knew that I am an exacting man, taking up that which I didn’t lay down, and reaping that which I didn’t sow.
verses.en_bbe: He said to him, By the words of your mouth you will be judged, you bad servant. You had knowledge that I am a hard man, taking up what I have not put down and getting in grain where I have not put seed;

verses.en: Wherefore then gavest not thou my money into the bank, that at my coming I might have required mine own with usury?
verses.pt: Por que, então, não puseste meu dinheiro no banco; e quando eu viesse, o receberia de volta com juros?
verses.en_web: Then why didn’t you deposit my money in the bank, and at my coming, I might have earned interest on it?’
verses.en_bbe: Why then did you not put my money in a bank, so that when I came I would get it back with interest?

verses.en: And he said unto them that stood by, Take from him the pound, and give it to him that hath ten pounds.
verses.pt: E disse aos que estavam com ele: Tirai-lhe a mina, e dai-a ao que tem as dez minas.
verses.en_web: He said to those who stood by, ‘Take the mina away from him, and give it to him who has the ten minas.’
verses.en_bbe: And he said to the others who were near, Take the pound away from him, and give it to the man who has ten.

verses.en: (And they said unto him, Lord, he hath ten pounds.)
verses.pt: E eles lhe disseram: Senhor, ele já tem dez minas.
verses.en_web: “They said to him, ‘Lord, he has ten minas!’
verses.en_bbe: And they say to him, Lord, he has ten pounds.

verses.en: For I say unto you, That unto every one which hath shall be given; and from him that hath not, even that he hath shall be taken away from him.
verses.pt: O senhor respondeu: Porque eu vos digo, que todo aquele que tiver, lhe será dado; mas ao que não tiver, até o que tem, lhe será tirado.
verses.en_web: ‘For I tell you that to everyone who has, will more be given; but from him who doesn’t have, even that which he has will be taken away from him.
verses.en_bbe: And I say to you that to everyone who has, more will be given, but from him who has not, even what he has will be taken away.

verses.en: But those mine enemies, which would not that I should reign over them, bring hither, and slay them before me.
verses.pt: Porém a aqueles meus inimigos, que não quiseram que eu reinasse sobre eles, trazei - os aqui, e matai -os diante de mim.
verses.en_web: But bring those enemies of mine who didn’t want me to reign over them here, and kill them before me.’”
verses.en_bbe: And as for those who were against me, who would not have me for their ruler, let them come here, and be put to death before me.

verses.en: And when he had thus spoken, he went before, ascending up to Jerusalem.
verses.pt: E dito isto, ele foi caminhando adiante, subindo para Jerusalém.
verses.en_web: Having said these things, he went on ahead, going up to Jerusalem.
verses.en_bbe: And when he had said this, he went on in front of them, going up to Jerusalem.

verses.en: And it came to pass, when he was come nigh to Bethphage and Bethany, at the mount called the mount of Olives, he sent two of his disciples,
verses.pt: E aconteceu que, chegando perto de Betfagé, e de Betânia, ao monte chamado das Oliveiras, mandou a dois de seus discípulos,
verses.en_web: When he came near to Bethsphage and Bethany, at the mountain that is called Olivet, he sent two of his disciples,
verses.en_bbe: And it came about that when he got near Beth-phage and Bethany by the mountain which is named the Mountain of Olives, he sent two of the disciples,

verses.en: Saying, Go ye into the village over against you; in the which at your entering ye shall find a colt tied, whereon yet never man sat: loose him, and bring him hither.
verses.pt: Dizendo: Ide à aldeia que está em frente; onde, ao entrardes, achareis um potro atado, em que ninguém jamais se sentou; soltai-o, e trazei -o.
verses.en_web: saying, “Go your way into the village on the other side, in which, as you enter, you will find a colt tied, which no man had ever sat upon. Untie it, and bring it.
verses.en_bbe: Saying, Go into the little town in front of you, and on going in you will see a young ass fixed with a cord, on which no man has ever been seated; let him loose and take him.

verses.en: And if any man ask you, Why do ye loose him? thus shall ye say unto him, Because the Lord hath need of him.
verses.pt: E se alguém vos perguntar: Por que o soltais? Direis assim a ele: Porque o Senhor precisa dele.
verses.en_web: If anyone asks you, ‘Why are you untying it?’ say to him: ‘The Lord needs it.’”
verses.en_bbe: And if anyone says to you, Why are you taking him? say, The Lord has need of him.

verses.en: And they that were sent went their way, and found even as he had said unto them.
verses.pt: E indo os que tinham sido mandados, acharam como lhes disse:
verses.en_web: Those who were sent went away, and found things just as he had told them.
verses.en_bbe: And those whom he sent went away, and it was as he said.

verses.en: And as they were loosing the colt, the owners thereof said unto them, Why loose ye the colt?
verses.pt: E soltando o potro, seus donos lhe disseram: Por que soltais o potro?
verses.en_web: As they were untying the colt, its owners said to them, “Why are you untying the colt?”
verses.en_bbe: And when they were getting the young ass, the owners of it said to them, Why are you taking the young ass?

verses.en: And they said, The Lord hath need of him.
verses.pt: E eles disseram: O Senhor precisa dele.
verses.en_web: They said, “The Lord needs it.”
verses.en_bbe: And they said, The Lord has need of him.

verses.en: And they brought him to Jesus: and they cast their garments upon the colt, and they set Jesus thereon.
verses.pt: E o trouxeram a Jesus; e lançando suas roupas sobre o potro, puseram Jesus montado nele.
verses.en_web: They brought it to Jesus. They threw their cloaks on the colt, and set Jesus on them.
verses.en_bbe: And they took him to Jesus, and they put their clothing on the ass, and Jesus got on to him.

verses.en: And as he went, they spread their clothes in the way.
verses.pt: E indo ele andando, estendiam suas roupas pelo caminho.
verses.en_web: As he went, they spread their cloaks on the road.
verses.en_bbe: And while he went on his way they put their clothing down on the road in front of him.

verses.en: And when he was come nigh, even now at the descent of the mount of Olives, the whole multitude of the disciples began to rejoice and praise God with a loud voice for all the mighty works that they had seen;
verses.pt: E quando já chegava perto da descida do monte das Oliveiras, toda a multidão de discípulos, com alegria começou a louvar a Deus em alta voz, por todas as maravilhas que tinham visto,
verses.en_web: As he was now getting near, at the descent of the Mount of Olives, the whole multitude of the disciples began to rejoice and praise God with a loud voice for all the mighty works which they had seen,
verses.en_bbe: And when he came near the foot of the Mountain of Olives, all the disciples with loud voices gave praise to God with joy, because of all the great works which they had seen;

verses.en: Saying, Blessed be the King that cometh in the name of the Lord: peace in heaven, and glory in the highest.
verses.pt: Dizendo: Bendito o Rei que vem em nome do Senhor; paz no céu, e glória nas alturas.
verses.en_web: saying, “Blessed is the King who comes in the name of the Lord! Peace in heaven, and glory in the highest!”
verses.en_bbe: Saying, A blessing on the King who comes in the name of the Lord; peace in heaven and glory in the highest.

verses.en: And some of the Pharisees from among the multitude said unto him, Master, rebuke thy disciples.
verses.pt: E alguns dos fariseus da multidão lhe disseram: Mestre, repreende a teus discípulos.
verses.en_web: Some of the Pharisees from the multitude said to him, “Teacher, rebuke your disciples!”
verses.en_bbe: And some of the Pharisees among the people said to him, Master, make your disciples be quiet.

verses.en: And he answered and said unto them, I tell you that, if these should hold their peace, the stones would immediately cry out.
verses.pt: E respondendo ele, disse-lhes: Digo-vos, que se estes se calarem, as pedras clamariam.
verses.en_web: He answered them, “I tell you that if these were silent, the stones would cry out.”
verses.en_bbe: And he said in answer, I say to you, if these men keep quiet, the very stones will be crying out.

verses.en: And when he was come near, he beheld the city, and wept over it,
verses.pt: E quando já estava chegando, viu a cidade, e chorou por causa dela,
verses.en_web: When he came near, he saw the city and wept over it,
verses.en_bbe: And when he got near and saw the town, he was overcome with weeping for it,

verses.en: Saying, If thou hadst known, even thou, at least in this thy day, the things which belong unto thy peace! but now they are hid from thine eyes.
verses.pt: Dizendo: Ah, se tu também conhecesses, pelo menos neste teu dia, aquilo que lhe traria paz! Mas agora isto está escondido de teus olhos.
verses.en_web: saying, “If you, even you, had known today the things which belong to your peace! But now, they are hidden from your eyes.
verses.en_bbe: Saying, If you, even you, had knowledge today, of the things which give peace! but you are not able to see them.

verses.en: For the days shall come upon thee, that thine enemies shall cast a trench about thee, and compass thee round, and keep thee in on every side,
verses.pt: Porque dias virão sobre ti, em que teus inimigos lhe cercarão com barricadas, e ao redor te sitiarão, e lhe pressionarão por todos os lados.
verses.en_web: For the days will come on you, when your enemies will throw up a barricade against you, surround you, hem you in on every side,
verses.en_bbe: For the time will come when your attackers will put a wall round you, and come all round you and keep you in on every side,

verses.en: And shall lay thee even with the ground, and thy children within thee; and they shall not leave in thee one stone upon another; because thou knewest not the time of thy visitation.
verses.pt: E derrubarão a ti, e a teus filhos; e não deixarão em ti pedra sobre pedra, porque não conheceste o tempo em que foste visitada.
verses.en_web: and will dash you and your children within you to the ground. They will not leave in you one stone on another, because you didn’t know the time of your visitation.”
verses.en_bbe: And will make you level with the earth, and your children with you; and there will not be one stone resting on another in you, because you did not see that it was your day of mercy.

verses.en: And he went into the temple, and began to cast out them that sold therein, and them that bought;
verses.pt: E entrando no Templo, começou a expulsar a todos os que vendiam e compravam ali,
verses.en_web: He entered into the temple, and began to drive out those who bought and sold in it,
verses.en_bbe: And he went into the Temple and put out those who were trading there,

verses.en: Saying unto them, It is written, My house is the house of prayer: but ye have made it a den of thieves.
verses.pt: Dizendo-lhes: Está escrito: Minha casa é casa de oração; Mas vós a tendes feito um esconderijo de ladrões.
verses.en_web: saying to them, “It is written, ‘My house is a house of prayer,’ but you have made it a ‘den of robbers’!”
verses.en_bbe: Saying to them, It has been said, My house is to be a house of prayer, but you have made it a hole of thieves.

verses.en: And he taught daily in the temple. But the chief priests and the scribes and the chief of the people sought to destroy him,
verses.pt: E ensinava diariamente no Templo; e os chefes dos sacerdotes, e os escribas, e os chefes do povo, procuravam matá-lo.
verses.en_web: He was teaching daily in the temple, but the chief priests and the scribes and the leading men among the people sought to destroy him.
verses.en_bbe: And every day he was teaching in the Temple. But the chief priests and the scribes and the rulers of the people were attempting to put him to death;

verses.en: And could not find what they might do: for all the people were very attentive to hear him.
verses.pt: E não achavam como fazer, porque todo o povo o ouvia com muita atenção.
verses.en_web: They couldn’t find what they might do, for all the people hung on to every word that he said.
verses.en_bbe: But they were not able to do anything, because the people all kept near him, being greatly interested in his words.
